This is a summary of the **electoral history of[Rishi Sunak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rishi_Sunak "Rishi Sunak")**, the [Leader of the Conservative Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leader_of_the_Conservative_Party_\(UK\) "Leader of the Conservative Party \(UK\)") who served as [Prime Minister of the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_the_United_Kingdom "Prime Minister of the United Kingdom") from October 2022 to July 2024. Sunak previously [served](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chancellorship_of_Rishi_Sunak "Chancellorship of Rishi Sunak") as [Chancellor of the Exchequer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chancellor_of_the_Exchequer "Chancellor of the Exchequer") from 2020 to 2022, and was the MP for [Richmond (Yorks)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richmond_\(Yorks\) "Richmond \(Yorks\)") from 2015 to 2024. Following boundary changes, Sunak's seat was abolished, and was reformed as [Richmond and Northallerton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richmond_and_Northallerton "Richmond and Northallerton"); first contested at the [2024 general election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_United_Kingdom_general_election "2024 United Kingdom general election") with Sunak as the Conservative candidate.
